name: su8l-devs
description: SU8L DEVs — Cloud Bot Service platform (server, bot, web)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,bot,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @su8l/server" "npm run dev -w @su8l/bot" "npm run dev -w @su8l/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @su8l/server && npm run build -w @su8l/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @su8l/server && npm run typecheck -w @su8l/bot && npm run typecheck -w @su8l/web
